explanation: What changes in the server's routine work. Locked reads right before acting (dead-session checks, message delivery) still go to disk; this leaves out the browser test limit, which is the open question.

items: Every 2-10s, each timer reads and parses all 116 thread files (18.5 MB)
Each open tab repeats that every 5-10s
Chat pulls the whole transcript every 2s
Every transcript ever shown stays in memory
Machine service waits on each tmux call, doing nothing else
Timers and tabs check file timestamps; only changed files are re-read
Fresh reads before acting are unchanged
Old transcripts are dropped from memory when not viewed
tmux calls run in the background; hidden tabs stop polling
